reviewer: Root implementation review of complete saved primary NSM chart and complete GSE bipolar declarations

warrant.reviewer: Root source/representation review; not presented as a new founder ruling
warrant.statement: The primary chart explicitly declares GOOD, BAD, BIG and SMALL as their respective elementary NSM meanings. GSE already declares GOOD/BAD as the EVALUATION antipodes and BIG/SMALL as the SIZE antipodes in both live registry and curation schema. For these exact monosemantic primary units, mapping the declared positive/negative pole supplies only the corresponding scalar sign. It supplies no orthogonal zero, complete signature, ordinary-English word-sense selection, or new bank meaning.

preserve: Every other unresolved coordinate remains unresolved absent independent justification.
NSM combinatorial frame participants are not copied as own-unit bank content.
No same-spelled ordinary dictionary sense receives these signs without its own proven semantic alignment.
Hierarchy level and ordinal metadata remain separate from base sign.
Existing metadata-only correspondence flags do not themselves authorize lexical writes; this explicit source-derived warrant must be consumed by ordinary tested projection/admission/migration.
must_not_examples: wordnet:good:commodity.n.01 is not the canonical NSM GOOD unit.
wordnet:bad:bad.s.01 (very intense) cannot inherit GOOD=-1 by spelling.
A positive GOOD projection cannot fill BIG=0 unless the existing iff absence guard independently licenses it.
experimental_scope: Independent source review, not a final held-out semantic score or observed corpus gain.
